askTitle: What you can do at home
asks: Measure how much water your building uses
Check pipes, tanks and valves; fix leaks fast; stop sumps overflowing
Reuse treated wastewater for gardens and flushing
Clean rooftop filters and recharge pits; keep rainwater harvesting working
Don't wash driveways or cars with drinking water
Shorter showers, full loads only, no running taps
next: The CM has warned the water crisis may last till July; Hyderabad faces supply cuts this season.
title: Every Drop Counts: Hyderabad colonies' plan to beat the water crunch
what: With reservoirs low and the Water Board asking everyone to cut use, RWAs have drawn up a water conservation plan any home or colony can follow.
who: Resident welfare associations across Hyderabad and Cyberabad (UFERWAS; E Ramana, president)
